title: Report: GTA 6 Super Mario Bros Easter Egg: Location and Steps
description: GameSpot details a GTA 6 Easter egg in Lummox County where players smash an invisible block to hear a nostalgic tune and collect caps referencing Jason and Lucia.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Super Mario Bros Easter Egg: How to Find the Hidden Caps
socialHook: GameSpot details a GTA 6 Easter egg where players smash an invisible block to collect Jason and Lucia caps.

sections.heading: Where to find the GTA 6 Super Mario Easter egg
paragraphs: GameSpot reports that the Easter egg is located in Lummox County, north of Mount Kalaga, at the end of a winding road in the woods. The area resembles a Super Mario Bros. stage, according to GameSpot.

sections.heading: How to activate the hidden block
paragraphs: GameSpot's steps say players should find a purple tarp with a bong, smoke it, then climb the structure in front of them. A plume of smoke marks a column where an invisible block appears when the player stands in it.

sections.heading: What players receive
paragraphs: According to GameSpot, jumping into the block does not award gold coins. Instead, it triggers a nostalgic tune and two caps embroidered with the letters J and L, referencing Jason and Lucia. GameSpot describes the caps as nods to Nintendo's Mario and Luigi.
